note: Chrome Settings branding and header area -- renders fixed browser interface vocabulary.
Settings navigation menu -- renders fixed Chrome Settings categories.
Chrome Settings toolbar -- renders fixed branding and search-interface vocabulary, excluding the entered search query.
Global Settings search widget chrome -- renders fixed search-field controls, excluding the user-entered query.
Back control for the Settings subpage -- renders fixed browser navigation vocabulary.
Settings subpage heading -- renders the fixed Chrome page title.
Search icon for the site-data page -- renders fixed Settings interface chrome.
Site-data search control chrome -- renders fixed search-field controls, excluding the entered filter text.
Sort control label -- renders the fixed vocabulary for sorting site records.
Site-list sort control -- renders the closed set of operator-defined sorting options.
Clear-data control label -- renders fixed Chrome Settings action vocabulary.
Clear-all site data control -- renders a fixed browser action and its control chrome.
